title: The AI QA & Security Co-Pilot
pitch: Combine the security-audit skill with e2e's natural-language test agent to offer a single 'ship it safely' service for small software teams: before every release, one AI pass hunts for vulnerabilities with independently verified findings, and another AI pass drives the actual app end-to-end to confirm nothing broke. Package it as a pre-release checklist a non-technical founder can run from the command line, or as a managed service where you run both passes on their repo and app before every deploy. The buyer is the same person either way: a small startup's technical lead who wants pentest-grade and QA-grade confidence without hiring two separate specialists.
why_now: Both repos trended on the same day because AI-driven verification (not just AI-driven generation) is the theme right now — teams that adopted AI coding assistants for speed are now actively looking for AI-assisted ways to catch what the speed cost them in security and test coverage.
